note: conformer_ensemble()'s torsion noise draws from Prng::new(), a process-global atomic Weyl-sequence counter (crates/chematic-3d/src/prng.rs:16) -- not caller-seedable, not tied to molecule/input content, order/thread-dependent. A1's ledger must record this as a named gap (not just prose): there is currently no way for a caller to get a reproducible ensemble. Contrast with embed_pipeline_v2's EmbedParameters.random_seed, which IS tested deterministic (same_seed_reproducible / different_seed_gives_different_output, distance_geometry_v2.rs). A2's design goal is exactly to give the ensemble path this same property.

Per docs/rfcs/etkdg_3d_gap_rfc.md's source-inspection finding: MMFF94's bond_energy_mmff94/angle_energy_mmff94 silently contribute zero energy/gradient for atom-type pairs the parameter tables don't cover, letting VdW repulsion push atoms apart unopposed. A halomethane stereocenter is the class of molecule most likely to hit uncovered MMFF94 atom-type pairs. A1's ledger must quantify how many of the 265-corpus's (or a small targeted extension's) molecules hit this specific mechanism, not just cite it as a theoretical possibility.

v0.18.0's assign_c_type fix (issue #337) changed MMFF94 atom types for chembl_tier_b_0071/_0082, both members of this corpus, and their BCI charges (6 atoms) -- but no CHANGELOG entry re-states the 265-corpus pass rate after that change, unlike v0.17.0's own PR #336 blast-radius disclosure. docs/benchmark.md, docs/rdkit-migration.md, and the v0.19.0 CHANGELOG all currently state 'no RMSD/TFD comparison against RDKit exists yet' -- this is false. The cited report already separates RMSD (mean 1.685 Angstrom), TFD (mean 0.2228), stereo satisfied/violated counts, and per-stage runtime as distinct measured metrics on the 265-molecule corpus. A1's ledger should formally republish this fact (not re-measure it) so a future doc-hygiene pass can correct the stale claim -- flagged here so it isn't lost, fixing the docs themselves is explicitly out of this RFC's own scope.

A1's design requirement: whatever the 265-corpus's macrocycle-containing members are (ring size >= MACROCYCLE_MIN = 9, etkdg_knowledge/classify.rs:24), their pass/fail/RMSD/TFD must be reported as an explicit, separate row in the ledger, never blended into the overall 241/265 headline -- matching this RFC's acceptance-criteria section 5's explicit requirement.
